And if you want all three without paying three subscriptions, skip the official apps and use a multi-model client. [...] ## System Requirements: Only Gemini Shuts Out Intel Macs

Only Gemini for Mac requires Apple Silicon. Google lists an M1 or newer Mac with macOS Sequoia 15 or newer, so Intel owners are limited to Gemini in the browser. ChatGPT needs macOS Sonoma 14 or newer and runs on Apple Silicon or Intel. Claude needs only macOS Big Sur 11 or newer and ships one universal download for both chip types.

If you’re on an older Mac, you have two paths. The first is a third-party Mac wrapper or multi-model client that still supports older systems. The second is using the AI in a browser tab, which we know nobody actually wants to do anymore. We’ve covered the full state of AI on older Macs in our Mac Mini for AI reality check if your hardware is the bottleneck.
